details:
IK and room-scale movement in general does break after respawning in given instance or recalibrating while in full-body.
Seems to be similar to tracked issue in open beta branch (https://feedback.vrchat.com/open-beta/p/1167-networked-ik-has-massive-degradation-issues-for-some-people) except this happens to me even on stable branch (and also on open beta).
Same as with above mentioned issue, everything looks ok locally - room-scale movement, hand, feet etc... IK - but for other people I don't move at all.
Tested with multiple SDK2 and SDK3 based avatars (both with and without stations), with and without full-body, 
everything is working fine until first (re)calibration - rejoining instance seems to help though. Did clean reinstall, switched to open-beta and back etc... still not working properly.
All other events sync properly (udon, items etc...) even some positional syncs happen for example when recalibrating I get teleported to proper place, but then IK never works.
Logs do not contain anything that could be of use even with verbose logging enabled.
